policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. Update measured counts in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances; never lower a floor without an explicit, justified scope change.

tolerance.rationale: The #369 body-observer ownership fix adds one instrumented and covered client/core line so stale handles compare their exact subscriber identity before cleanup, advancing the reviewed high-water from 2326/2666 (87.247%) to 2327/2667 (87.252%). Two clean Node 22.20/V8 runs on 2026-07-27 each passed all 1788 tests across 233 files and reproduced exactly 2327/2667. Retaining the existing one-line tolerance makes the minimum 2326/2667 (87.214%), stricter than the prior 2325/2666 tolerated floor (87.209%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

The final #453 injected-shell HTTP boundary pass replaces the larger overflow stream with bounded buffering plus untouched host replay, uses four fixed admission stripes to single-flight cold fills and source invalidations, makes cold/changed HEAD bodyless, and collapses Accept-Encoding keys to the finite identity/gzip/Brotli negotiation state. That refactor removes 22 obsolete instrumented lines while adding covered fallback, concurrency, HEAD, finite-key, and real response-compression regressions. Six clean .NET 10.0.9/Coverlet runs on 2026-07-27 each passed all 2,300 tests; runs 3 through 6 reproduced the reviewed high-water exactly at 27,321/36,038 instrumented lines (75.812%). Retaining the existing evidence-bounded five-line Coverlet tolerance makes the minimum 27,316/36,038 (75.798%), stricter than the prior 27,311/36,060 tolerated floor (75.738%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
